resolvable_detail.vegastrike-engine-git: Spaceflight sim, C++/CMake, deps in Guix (boost, sdl2, openal, freeglut, gtk, libvorbis, glu). Feasible.
resolvable_detail.gst-plugins-rs-git: GStreamer Rust plugins, meson build, deps in Guix (gstreamer, dav1d, gtk, libsodium, libwebp). Needs cargo-c (packageable).
resolvable_detail.python-google-cloud-speech: Python package, deps in Guix (python-google-api-core, python-grpcio, python-grpcio-status, python-proto-plus, python-protobuf). Standard pyproject build.
resolvable_detail.scans2any-git: Python scan converter, most deps in Guix (python-jinja2, python-pandas, python-pydantic, python-rich, python-tabulate, python-defusedxml). Needs python-libnmap + python-partial-json-parser (both small, packageable).
resolvable_detail.oclint: Static analysis tool for C/C++, CMake/ninja build, deps in Guix (clang, llvm, libxml2, icu4c). Standard C++ build.
resolvable_detail.codeblocks-svn: C/C++ IDE, autotools/make build, deps in Guix (wxwidgets, gtk, boost, hunspell). Feasible with wxwidgets.
resolvable_detail.deadbeef-git: GTK audio player, autotools build, most deps in Guix (ffmpeg, gtk, alsa-lib, flac, libvorbis, mpg123, etc). Needs libblocksruntime (small, packageable).
resolvable_detail.texpresso-git: LaTeX live renderer, cargo+C build, deps in Guix (mupdf, sdl2, fontconfig, freetype, harfbuzz, openssl, re2c). Feasible.
resolvable_detail.ghostty-git-zen3: Terminal emulator, Zig build, deps in Guix (gtk, libadwaita, gtk4-layer-shell, harfbuzz, fontconfig, oniguruma, pixman, sdl2, zig). Feasible.
resolvable_detail.thunderbird-beta: Mozilla Thunderbird beta, same build as Thunderbird (not in upstream Guix but synfigstudio-level effort). Very complex but mainstream.
resolvable_detail.thunderbird-globalmenu: Thunderbird variant with global menu. Same complexity as thunderbird-beta.
resolvable_detail.veloren: Voxel RPG, Rust/cargo build, deps in Guix (alsa-lib, vulkan-loader). Feasible but large Rust project.
resolvable_detail.waytrogen: Rust GUI wallpaper setter, meson+cargo build, deps in Guix (gtk, ffmpeg, sqlite). Feasible.
resolvable_detail.java-openjfx-nowebkit: OpenJFX without WebKit, Java/Gradle build, deps partially in Guix (java-openjfx-* packages exist). Feasible but complex Java build.
resolvable_detail.pantheon-polkit-agent-git: Polkit agent, meson/vala build, deps in Guix (granite, polkit, vala, gtk). Feasible.
resolvable_detail.php-legacy-pdlib: PHP extension for dlib, CMake build, deps in Guix (dlib, php). Feasible.
